and dependencies using knip.

- Add knip.config.ts with workspace configuration
- Add `pnpm deadcode` and `pnpm deadcode:fix` scripts
- Update .husky/pre-commit to run dead code check

- Update .claude/settings.json to include the stop hook

+#!/bin/bash
+
+cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0
+
+# Verify we're in the right project
+if [[ ! -f "claude-remote-control/package.json" ]]; then
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+cd claude-remote-control || exit 0
+
+echo "Checking for dead code..."
+pnpm deadcode 2>&1
+
+DEADCODE_EXIT=$?
+
+if [ $DEADCODE_EXIT -eq 0 ]; then
+  echo "No dead code found"
+  exit 0
+else
+  echo "Dead code detected. Please remove unused code before completing." >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
